Hello LAVAAN members

Introduction to Survey Methodology led by Tarek Al Baghal (Institute of Social and Economic Research, University of Essex) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This workshop on survey methodology offers crucial insights for researchers working with latent variables. Mastering survey design, sampling, and questionnaire construction directly enhances the quality of data used in analyses with tools like lavaan. By applying these principles, you can mitigate measurement error and improve data reliability, leading to more robust and interpretable latent variable models in your own research.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
